newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen Central Bank cuts bank deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Yemen Central Bank cuts bank deposit rates.

text.p: The Central Bank of Yemen said on Saturday it had reduced interest rates on savings deposits to 12 percent from 14 percent in a bid to reform its banking sector.
A statement by the Central Bank put the minimum interest rate on savings deposits at 12 percent but said rates on various term deposits would be set by individual banks on the basis of the set floor.
It said interest on deposits in foreign currencies will be set at international market rates less half a percentage point.
The new minimum interest rate level would not apply to Islamic banks, it added.
Yemen, one of the Arab world's poorest states, reduced interest rates on bank deposits by five percentage points in December.
The Central Bank said earlier that high rates on deposits translated into high interest rates on facilities and loans.
